title: Wash tank fill timeout
shortDescription: Tank did not fill within allowed time.
fullDescription: Winterhalter UC/PT did not detect water at fill probe within timeout. Check supply, strainer, and fill valve.

title: Boiler fill timeout
shortDescription: Boiler did not fill in time.
fullDescription: Pressure boiler fill failed. Often pressure boiler vent or fill solenoid issue.

title: Drain pump fault
shortDescription: Tank did not drain in time.
fullDescription: Drain pump did not evacuate water. Clean pump impeller and check check-valve.

fixSteps.title: Clean strainers
fixSteps.instruction: Remove sump strainer and clear debris.

faq.a: Always prerinse to reduce pump clogs.

title: Boiler heating fault
fullDescription: Rinse boiler element timed out. Possible scale or element failure.

title: Tank heating fault
shortDescription: Wash tank did not reach temperature.
fullDescription: Tank element timed out. Scale or element issue.

title: Wash pump fault
fullDescription: Pump motor not running or overload tripped.

faq.a: Foreign objects in pump are common.

title: Hood/door switch fault
shortDescription: Hood or door not closed at cycle start.
fullDescription: PT hood or UC door switch did not detect closed position.

fixSteps.title: Close fully
fixSteps.instruction: Lower hood or close door fully.

faq.a: Tank and boiler each have separate NTC.

title: General system fault
fullDescription: Generic fault often indicating PCB or sensor issue. Cycle aborted.

fixSteps.title: Service
fixSteps.instruction: Tech runs diagnostic and replaces PCB.
